content: {"phoneNote":"Phone first screen works: salon photo, name, headline and intro in order, but the hero lacks any sense of place and the opening-hours timeline turns into tall repetitive bars that eat a full screen.","desktopNote":"Desktop hero is solid, yet the page has dead bands between sections (below the hero, under the hours, under the services) and a near-empty 'Kdo vas postriže' team block with no faces.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":2,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Tighten vertical padding: remove the empty bands after the hero, hours and services on desktop (and the gap below the phone hero) for a consistent rhythm.","Add a short address/location line to the hero so where the salon is reads right after what it does.","Give 'Kdo vas postriže' portraits or at least a short line per person; two names with underlines on an empty band looks unfinished."],"blockers":[]}
